description: This is a Flutter application's main entry point file that sets up and runs the app. It defines the main widget MyApp, which creates a MaterialApp with a home page MyHomePage. The MyHomePage widget displays a simple UI indicating that the Tic Tac Toe frontend is being generated, including an AppBar and a loading indicator.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: The root widget of the application that sets up the MaterialApp with a title, theme, and home page.

classes.name: MyHomePage
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays the main content of the home screen, including an AppBar and some placeholder text.

classes.name: _MyHomePageState
classes.description: The state class for MyHomePage that builds the Scaffold containing the app's main UI.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The entry point of the Dart application that calls runApp to start the Flutter app with MyApp.

methods.name: build
methods.description: A method in MyApp that builds the MaterialApp widget.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for MyHomePage.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for _MyHomePageState, constructing the Scaffold and layout.
